verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5080 page says the card can run the latest AI models locally and names inference backends (Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch) it is optimized for, which is a thin first-party local-inference story. Nothing in the pack mentions low-precision formats or the specific serving stacks the story names. missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 low-precision support for this part, named TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support, LLM-specific inference documentation or benchmarks, independent hands-on corroboration of LLM inference on the 5080.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part

citations.quote: Access curated, GPU-optimized SDKs and models, and maximize performance across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch, and other inference backends.
Stay ahead with the latest AI models the moment they drop - running faster, smoother, and fully private on your RTX-powered PC.
